items.subject: Application | Special Education Teacher, ACS Doha | Amer AlSaaideh
items.htmlBody:
Dear ACS Doha International School Hiring Team,

I am Amer Abdeljalil, a special education specialist with an MA in Special Education (Excellent) and over five years as a resource room teacher and inclusive education coordinator in Jordanian Ministry of Education schools. I have also worked in Qatar as a special education specialist. The school offers the full IB continuum (PYP, MYP and DP) and a US High School Diploma pathway.

  • Managed an individual education plan (IEP) for each student, built on formal and informal assessments.
  • Achieved full inclusion of students with disabilities for the first time in a public school.

I am applying for a Learning Support / Special Education Teacher, Resource Room Teacher or Inclusion Coordinator role. Please find my CV attached.

Kind regards,

Amer Abdeljalil AlSaaideh
Special Education Specialist | Inclusive Education Coordinator
MA in Special Education (Excellent) | 5+ years in Jordan and Qatar
Phone / WhatsApp+962 78 018 9766
Emailamer.abdeljalil77@gmail.com
LinkedInView my LinkedIn profile
Available immediately | Open to relocation
